messages:
mike-partnerships: ApertureModels just shared a package for 'Aperture-XL-1'. LICENSE.txt says 'non-commercial research only'. They mentioned potential cloud marketplace distribution. Need quick alignment on what lanes we can offer.
leah-legal: Research-only blocks commercial listing and Dedicated resells. Short path: negotiate a narrow Distribution Addendum permitting hosting and distribution of runtime artifacts while forbidding raw checkpoint redistribution. Also require export declarations.
simon-eng: Bundle contains checkpoints + tokenizer + an appliance-only kernel binary. If they forbid raw weights, we can still host but need a redistributable runtime binary with checksum or source for the kernel. Also request a 50-prompt eval set.
rosa-ops: Ops: don't accept cross-account roles on their bucket. Ask for presigned downloads, signed manifest (SHA256), and GPG-signed provenance. For SI installs we'll need explicit permission to push installer images to customer accounts.
tara-ml: Add ask: detailed compatibility matrix (max context, tokenizer norm, FP16/INT8 support) and perf numbers for small/med/large batch. We use that for model cards and Optimize recommendations.
ali-marketing: Marketing wants a co-announcement slot in 4 weeks. If legal + eng can sign off within 10 business days we'll be good.
mike-partnerships: Leah, can you paste a 2-line clause we can send to Aperture to speed negotiation?
leah-legal: Starter clause: "Supplier grants Redwood a non-exclusive, worldwide license to host and distribute compiled runtime artifacts and containers to Redwood customers. Redistribution of raw checkpoints is prohibited. Each release must include a signed manifest (SHA256) and provenance. SI/on-prem transfers require a per-customer addendum and KYC."
integations-bot: created TASK PARTNERS-678: "ApertureModels DLA & artifact checklist" assigned to mike-partnerships.
